title: Lecturer on Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences
bio: Dr. Meghan Cooper graduated cum laude with her Doctor of Dental Medicine (DMD) degree from the Harvard School of Dental Medicine. She completed both a Certificate in Endodontics and a Master of Medical Sciences (MMSc) in Oral Biology at Harvard. Her clinical expertise includes conventional and surgical endodontic care, such as root canal therapy and retreatment, dental trauma management, resorption repair, and regenerative endodontic procedures. Cooper is a Diplomate of the American Board of Endodontics and an active member of the American Association of Endodontists, the Omicron Kappa Upsilon National Dental Honor Society, and the Massachusetts Association of Endodontists. She serves as a clinical instructor and lecturer in the Advanced Graduate Program in Endodontics at HSDM and maintains a private practice in Boston.
